subject: Scheduling: Tech deep dive (Solutions + Customer Architects) - timezone overlap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@acme-analytics.com>, Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@acme-analytics.eu>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Tech deep dive (Solutions + Customer Architects) - timezone overlap

Hi Asha / Marco,

Thanks again for the interest - we'd love to set up a technical deep dive with our Solutions team so your architects can walk through your ingestion pattern and we can map performance/cost profiles. Because your team spans EU and APAC, wanted to confirm overlap windows that work before we lock a session.

High-level asks:
- Who needs to join from your side (names + titles)?
- Any constraints on time (e.g., no meetings before 9am local)?
- Preferred length: we expect 60 - 75 minutes (presentation + Q&A + hands-on run).

Attached is a suggested agenda and a timezone-overlap matrix I put together (demo-agenda.pdf; timezone-overlap-matrix.xlsx).

Some preliminary windows that often work for mixed EU/APAC/US teams:
- 16:00 - 18:00 CET (overlaps with early APAC mornings and late US mornings)
- 07:30 - 09:30 CET (early EU, overlaps with US mornings and late APAC evenings)

We can be flexible - Sean (cc'd) will lead the technical portion. If you share a couple of 1-hour slots over the next 2 weeks that work for your architects, we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Asha Reddy <asha@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@acme-analytics.eu>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:03:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Tech deep dive (Solutions + Customer Architects) - timezone overlap

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for this and for the matrix. On our side:
- Participants: me (Lead Platform Architect), Marco (EU data architect), and potentially Li Wei (APAC infra lead).
- Constraints: Marco is usually unavailable before 10:00 CET. Li Wei is UTC+8 and prefers after 15:00 his local.
- Preferred length: 75 minutes is fine.

Given constraints, the best overlap windows we see next week are (all in CET):
- Tue 06 Apr 16:00 - 17:15 CET (Marco available after 17:15 would be tight)
- Wed 07 Apr 07:30 - 08:45 CET (early for Marco but might work)
- Thu 08 Apr 15:30 - 16:45 CET (this gives Li Wei a later local time)

Note: we are in the middle of daylight-savings changes in some regions - Marco's timezone will switch to CEST on 28 Mar. I flagged this in the matrix but thought I'd call it out.

Best,
Asha
Lead Platform Architect | Acme Analytics
asha@acme-analytics.com

Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Tech deep dive (Solutions + Customer Architects) - timezone overlap

Hi all -

Thanks for the availability. Quick notes from the Solutions engineering side:
- 75 minutes is perfect; I'll allocate time to deep-dive on KV cache behavior, batching, and a short live run of a 10k-token sequence so your infra folks can judge memory/latency.
- For the run, we typically need an extra 15 minutes for setup if we demo against a sample dataset; is that OK?

From Asha's windows, Thu 08 Apr 15:30 - 16:45 CET looks best to give both Marco and Li Wei reasonable local times. If we use that slot, please confirm whether the session should be recorded (for async colleagues).

Also - small daylight-savings gotcha: US daylight savings starts 14 Mar 2026, EU shifts 28 Mar 2026 (CEST). If anyone is syncing invites in local time, double-check the calendar engine when creating cross-region invites.

If Marissa confirms, I'll pencil the slot and prepare the demo infra.

 - Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com

Hi Asha / Marco -

Thanks - Thu 08 Apr 15:30 - 16:45 CET works for us. We'll plan for 75 minutes + 15 minutes setup (90 total).

I've sent a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-demo-invite (please verify your displayed time - I created the invite in UTC to avoid local DST mismatches).

Agenda attached (demo-agenda.pdf). Please let me know if you want any additional topics (auth patterns, KMS/HSM, or private deployment questions).

Recording: we'll record the session and share a link after - confirm if that's OK.
